newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy nearbys drop, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy nearbys drop, corn steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf nearby soybean offers continued to decline on Monday while corn values was mostly steady to firmer, dealer said.
The spread volatility and the gains on the Chicago Board of Trade soybeans may have contributed to the drop in FOB soybeans, one dealer said.
Farms sales in both soybeans and corn were slow, he said.
